_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Tic Tac Toe.
Say gawa mo et baleg so talo iranan to (papalawen, bertikal, o diagonal) ed tabla.
No ontan mo so turno, say gawa mo et pili so numero na kuadrado (0-8) mo et ibagak ed marka mo ed sikan.
No example, '[4]' ibaga neken diad marka mo ed sentro a cell ed tabla.
Awan mo so Player {player_id}, ikaw so '{symbol}', no say kaiba mo so '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say inyakar ya sulat et aliwan unong ed dugan pormat.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} aliwan valid cell. Nepeg ya walad baetan na 0 tan 8.

game_action.placed: Say Player {player_id} napanek neken diad simbolo to ({symbol}) ed cell {cell}.
